libOverrides.source-storybook.mjs: bundlePreviewDecorators' esbuild call hardcodes loader {'.js','.json'}; .storybook/preview.tsx reaches component .scss through PageWrapper, so the decorator bundle failed and previews lost unpackDecorator (args are pack()ed — every component would render flattened props). Fork widens that one loader map to STORY_LOADERS, and points storybookStubPlugin at the story-imports fork below (the decorator bundle imports it directly, bypassing loadLib's fork seam).
libOverrides.story-imports.mjs: INERT_STUB materializes only a fixed list of @storybook/* named exports; .storybook/themes.ts does `import { create } from 'storybook/theming'` and calls it at module scope, so create was undefined and the decorator bundle threw 'import_theming.create is not a function' in 68/73 previews. Fork adds the theming API names to that list.
libOverrides.preview-gen-storybook.mjs: Story args are pack()ed (dot-flattened); the repo un-flattens them with the preview-level unpackDecorator, which relies on Storybook's Story(ctx) contract. The preview host hands __dsDecorate a pre-built element and a ctx-ignoring Story thunk, so that decorator no-ops and nested props arrived as literal 'image.srcMobile' keys — silently dropping headlines/buttons/arrays on every nested-arg component. Fork calls unpack() on the merged args at the same point in the chain Storybook does.
